description: Preview auto-fixes without modifying any files. Shows what would be changed: which unused exports would be removed, which unused dependencies would be deleted from package.json, which unused enum members would be removed, which unused pnpm catalog entries would be cleaned up, and which duplicate-export `ignoreExports` rules would be added to the fallow config file. For `add-to-config` actions, each fix entry carries a `proposed_diff` field with the unified-diff preview of the proposed config write. When no fallow config exists outside a monorepo subpackage, fix_apply would CREATE `.fallowrc.json` using `fallow init`'s framework-aware scaffolding (`$schema`, `entry`, `ignorePatterns`, etc.) and layer the `ignoreExports` rules on top; preview entries on that path carry `created_files: [".fallowrc.json"]`. Set `no_create_config: true` to skip the config-creation path with `skip_reason: "no_create_config"`; source-file previews are unaffected. When a source file's xxh3 content hash at preview time differs from the hash captured during the in-process analysis (a concurrent source edit), the per-file entry is emitted with `skip_reason: "content_changed"` and the envelope's top-level `skipped_content_changed` count is incremented; re-run after refreshing analysis. When a source file mixes CRLF and bare-LF line endings, the per-file entry is emitted with `skip_reason: "mixed_line_endings"` and the envelope's top-level `skipped_mixed_line_endings` count is incremented; this skip is NOT self-healing because re-running fallow alone does not normalize the file. The agent must run `dos2unix <path>` (or instruct the user to set `git config core.autocrlf input` and re-checkout) before re-running. When an unused export lives in a test, mock, or fixture directory, or in a file that itself has an unresolved import, its removal is withheld as low confidence because the consumer may be invisible to static analysis: the per-file entry carries `skip_reason: "low_confidence_off_graph"` or `"low_confidence_unresolved_imports"` and the envelope's top-level `skipped_low_confidence_exports` count is incremented. A finding carrying `reachability_caveats` (a file the run did not fully analyze may hold the crediting reference) is withheld the same way, `remove-dependency`, `remove-enum-member` and `remove-class-member` too, under `skip_reason: "low_confidence_incomplete_analysis"`, counted by `skipped_low_confidence_dependencies` and `skipped_low_confidence_members` (which counts both member kinds). Unlike the two skips above these are INTENTIONAL and do NOT change the exit code; the finding stays reported by `fallow dead-code` for manual confirmation. Supports workspace scoping and performance tuning (no_cache, threads).

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

max_output_bytes.description:
Byte cap for this call's response. Lowers the server cap (default
1000000); over it the call is REFUSED (`isError`, `exit_code: 2`).

no_create_config.description:
Refuse to create a new fallow config file when none exists. Use this
from pre-commit hooks and CI bots where silently materializing a new
top-level config file would surprise the user.

production.description:
Production mode: exclude test, story, and dev files, only start/build
scripts, and report type-only dependencies.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

show_cascade.description:
Also fix the unused exports, types, class members and enum members
of unused files. By default `fix` skips them, as the report hides
them. Passed through to the CLI's `--show-cascade` flag.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: fix_preview
